# svelte-tooltip-gca

> Modern, theme-aware tooltip action (use:tooltip) for Svelte 5: automatic light/dark themes, mobile touch support, top-layer Popover API rendering and zero dependencies. Docs, quick start, API reference and live playground.

svelte-tooltip-gca is an npm package that adds tooltips to any Svelte 5 element through a single Svelte action. It requires Svelte `^5.0.0` as a peer dependency and works in SvelteKit, Vite and any Svelte 5 app.

## Optional

- Package name: `svelte-tooltip-gca`
- Latest version: `1.0.4`
- License: MIT
- Author: AnonymousGCA (https://anonymousgca.eu)
- Dependencies: 0 runtime dependencies; peer dependency `svelte ^5.0.0`

- [Docs & Demo site](https://gabryca.github.io/svelte-tooltip-gca/): official documentation with a live playground, API reference, theming guide and FAQ
- [Full docs for LLMs (llms-full.txt)](https://gabryca.github.io/svelte-tooltip-gca/llms-full.txt): the complete documentation as a single Markdown file
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/svelte-tooltip-gca): install with `npm install svelte-tooltip-gca`
